assessment: Here, the authors characterize axon-initial segment-like structures in Drosophila using a variety of approaches spanning molecular genetic, confocal and super-resolution imaging, and ultrastructure. These important findings advance our understanding of how myelin evolved with potentially early roles in organizing ion channel clustering in axons. The convincing evidence supporting the conclusions includes advanced imaging combined with molecular genetic approaches, which will be of significant interest to neuroscientists and cell biologists.
